The Dow dropped more than 1,100 points Wednesday, then closed higher.
Dow: down 2.2% at the low, closed up 164 points (+0.33%) at 50,182.95.
S&P 500: down as much as 3.2%, closed down 0.25% at 7,182.78. Nasdaq: down as much as 4.6%, closed down 0.62%. Nvidia closed down almost 4%.
Our math: $1,000 tracking the S&P 500 was worth $968 at the low and $997.50 at the close. Stock markets are closed for Thanksgiving and close early at 1 PM ET Friday.
Sources: Fox Business, CNBC, AP, NYSE (Nov 25, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
